      // check cookie on page load 
      function checkCookie(id) {
          var adstate = Mage.Cookies.get("jsNoBrandAdState");
          if (adstate != null && adstate != "") {
              setState(adstate, id);
          } else {
              adstate = "expanded";
              setCookie("jsNoBrandAdState", adstate, 1);
              jQuery('#' + id).show();
          }
      }
       // adjust ad state and cookie setting on user click to change state
      function setState(state, id) {
          var adstate = state;
          if (adstate == "expanded") {
              jQuery('#' + id).show();
          } else {
              jQuery('#' + id).remove();
          }
      }

      function handleClick(id) {
          // obtain current cookie contents
          var adstate = Mage.Cookies.get("jsNoBrandAdState");
          if (adstate == "expanded") {
              jQuery('#' + id).remove();
              setCookie("jsNoBrandAdState", "collapsed", 1);
          } else {
              jQuery('#' + id).show();
              setCookie("jsNoBrandAdState", "expanded", 1);
          }
      }
	  
      function setCookie(name, value, exdays) {
		  var expireAt = Mage.Cookies.expires;
		  if (exdays > 0) {
				expireAt = new Date();
				expireAt.setTime(expireAt.getTime() + exdays * 86400000);//86400000=1day
			}
		  Mage.Cookies.set(name, value, expireAt);
      }

      (function ($) {
          checkCookie("topAdUnit");
          (function () {
              $ToTopFun = function () {
                  var st = $(document).scrollTop(),
                      winh = $(window).height();
                  (st > 0) ? $("#topAdUnit").hide() : $("#topAdUnit").show();
              };
              $(window).bind("scroll", $ToTopFun);
              $(function () {
                  $ToTopFun();
              });
          })();
      })(jQuery);
</script>
